description: This file defines a React hook called useFocusTrap that traps keyboard focus within a specified container element for accessibility purposes. It includes utility functions to identify focusable elements and manages focus on open, tab navigation, escape key handling, and focus restoration.

methods.name: getFocusableElements(container)
methods.description: Retrieves all focusable elements within a container, filtering out hidden or disabled elements.

methods.name: useFocusTrap(open, { containerRef, initialFocusRef, onEscape, allowOutsideClick = true } = {})

ctags.name: useFocusTrap
ctags.pattern: /^export function useFocusTrap(open, { containerRef, initialFocusRef, onEscape, allowOutsideClick /
